pipeline_blocker: catalog_mega_3d_production.py currently requires source_resource_id PM prefix to equal pokedex_number; accept the audited explicit source developer number before processing.
research_notes: Gen 6, Gen 7 and Gen 8 source IDs follow local developer-number CSVs.
Gen 9 Mega IDs were matched against their form icons and Scarlet/Violet base-form icons; Tatsugiri source has distinct Curly/Droopy/Stretchy icon variants.
Meowstic has one Mega source resource and its normal icon matches the male appearance; the female Mega mapping remains unconfirmed.
Diancie maps to pm0772_51_00. pm0719_51_00 is Delphox, explaining the earlier rejected Diancie candidate.
Each unique source resource contains 39–47 animation banks; selected native action set lacks sleep and a second physical attack.
